subtitle: Lesson 16 · Containment Strategies

eyebrow: The tension this chapter has circled
code:
Power off the machine
  -> stops the attack
  -> destroys volatile memory: processes, keys, connections

Isolate the machine instead
  -> stops the attack
  -> keeps the machine live for evidence capture
caption: The fastest-looking move can quietly destroy what a later review will need.
